descriptionChirho: The proper name Judah (Iouda), used in genitive constructions referring to the patriarch Judah son of Jacob, the tribe of Judah, or the territory/land of Judah. In NT genealogies and geographic references (Matthew 1-2, Luke 3, Hebrews 7:14, Revelation 5:5, 7:5). Multilingual evidence: Hindi 'yahuda', Arabic 'yahudha', Korean 'yuda-ui', Swahili 'Yuda', Spanish 'Juda'. All 7 occurrences in this cluster consistently refer to the OT Judah or his tribal/territorial legacy.

labelChirho: Joda (ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy)
descriptionChirho: The proper name Joda (Iōda), a person mentioned only in Luke 3:26 in the genealogy of Jesus through Mary's line, listed as the son of Joanan and father of Josech. This is a distinct individual from the patriarch Judah. Multilingual evidence distinguishes this person: Hindi 'yoda', Arabic 'yuda', Korean 'yoda-ui', Swahili 'Ioda', Spanish 'Ioda'. The single occurrence in Luke's genealogy refers to an otherwise unknown ancestor unrelated to the tribe of Judah.
